patterns.note: The homepage features an asymmetrical, staggered grid layout for project thumbnails, where images of varying aspect ratios are arranged in a visually dynamic, non-uniform composition.
A single, clean sans-serif typeface is used consistently across all text elements, with subtle variations in weight and size to establish hierarchy without introducing visual clutter.

A consistent, very light off-white background (#f5f2ed) dominates the site, providing a clean, expansive canvas that allows the rich architectural photography to be the primary source of color and visual interest.
Individual project images on the homepage reveal with a subtle animation (a gentle fade-in and slight upward translation) as they scroll into the viewport, creating a soft, engaging reveal effect.

Interior project pages are structured with a prominent full-width hero image at the top, followed by a series of smaller detail images and descriptive text blocks, creating a clear and focused project showcase.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to animate individual project thumbnail images on the homepage. As each image enters the viewport, it performs a subtle fade-in and a slight upward translation, creating a gentle, staggered reveal effect.

The homepage employs a responsive, asymmetrical grid system where project images of varying aspect ratios are arranged to create a visually dynamic and non-uniform layout, breaking from typical rigid grids.

A single, minimalist sans-serif typeface is used throughout the site, with typographic hierarchy established through subtle changes in font weight and size rather than multiple font families, maintaining a clean and understated aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, understated navigation and body text (~14-16px) with slightly larger, bolder project titles (~20-24px) and very large, thin page titles on interior pages (~3-4x body).
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners on all elements, including images and structural components, contributing to a precise and modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous padding around content blocks and significant negative space, especially on interior project pages, creating a sense of calm and focus.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an asymmetrical, almost collage-like grid for project previews on the homepage, combined with a highly minimalist aesthetic that prioritizes large, high-quality architectural photography, makes it feel more like an art gallery than a typical portfolio.
